versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the `oo-product-fruits` skill for working with Product Fruits through OOMOL-connected accounts.
- Uses the `oo` CLI and `product_fruits` connector so credentials are handled server-side.
- Supports listing knowledge-base articles and categories.
- Supports retrieving localized knowledge-base category details by correlation ID.
- Supports fetching localized article content in Markdown or HTML.
- Includes safety guidance, schema inspection workflow, and first-time setup troubleshooting.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`
